title: Mohd. Iqbal Ansari v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Sanjay Misra, J.; Anant Kumar, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; licensee to decide Clause 4.3 application in accordance with law expeditiously.
headnote: On the licensee's statement that a new-connection application complying with Clause 4.3 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 would be considered in accordance with law, the High Court disposed of the writ directing an expeditious decision, noting that electricity is an essential service and it was summer.
facts: Mohd. Iqbal Ansari filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court seeking a new electricity connection from the distribution licensee (respondents 2 and 3). At the outset of the hearing, counsel for the licensee submitted that Clause 4.3 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 governs new connections and that if the petitioner had applied in accordance with that clause, the licensee would consider the application in accordance with law. The Court disposed of the petition on that statement.

holding_units.topic: new connection — consider application in accordance with law
holding_units.holding: If the petitioner complies with Clause 4.3 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the licensee shall take a decision on the new-connection application in accordance with law expeditiously, electricity being an essential service.

not_decided.point: Entitlement to a new connection on the merits
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine whether the petitioner had applied or complied with Clause 4.3, or whether a connection was due.
